scope: Linux x86-64 (Ubuntu 24.04), Python 3.11-3.13, local providers only (mock, openai_compat, anthropic) against a locally hosted OpenAI-compatible server; single-user, single-host, local authority; no public service exposure and no distributed workers.
note: Every decision below is the author's own. No criterion is marked PASS, because the policy requires a named independent reviewer for a PASS and no such reviewer has reproduced these results. INCONCLUSIVE means the implementation and its in-repo evidence exist but no independent party has reproduced them; MISSING means the artefacts the policy requires do not exist at all.

C1.blocked_on: an independent reviewer must reproduce the output-mismatch counterexample through both the gate and the run entry point

evidence.description: the verdict uses the complete check result (exit code and every match predicate), not the exit code alone
every check executor records its complete verdict and the individual predicates
negative cases across the supported check kinds, including the exit-zero output mismatch through both entry points

counterexamples: a command that exits zero while producing the wrong output was accepted by the previous implementation; the counterexample is now covered by tests/evaluation/test_adversarial_contracts.py

C2.blocked_on: an independent reviewer must attempt contract mutation through planning, retry and replanning

evidence.description: the immutable, content-hashed request contract and its outcome vocabulary
the contract is built from the owner's declaration, never from the model's output
the contract cannot be weakened by a plan

C3.blocked_on: the 300-case corpus must be complete and an independent reviewer must confirm zero false accepts with the stated confidence bound

evidence.description: the evaluation statistics with complete denominators and clustered intervals
the hand-written adversarial corpus the generated corpus extends

C4.blocked_on: an independent reviewer must attempt deletion, rewrite and modify-then-restore tampering through every worker execution path

evidence.description: protected verification material and its tamper detection
the capability layer that keeps write authority outside the worker's hands

C5.blocked_on: an independent reviewer must confirm the CLI, API, persisted records and dashboard agree on every outcome

evidence.description: the CLI entry point
the HTTP API entry point
the contract between the runtime and the dashboard

R1.blocked_on: an independent reviewer must inject a blocking operation and a cancellation into every phase and confirm the D+5s bound

evidence.description: the absolute run deadline with the teardown reserve

R2.blocked_on: an independent reviewer must run the 100-cycle lifecycle matrix on a clean host and confirm zero survivors within five seconds

evidence.description: the process and artifact registry that owns what a run starts
the lifecycle-cycle and resource-bound tests

R3.blocked_on: an independent reviewer must attempt concurrent resume through the real entry points and confirm exactly one owner survives

evidence.description: ownership is acquired, heartbeated and released around every run
a resume takes durable ownership too
the ownership, fencing and dedup tests

R4.blocked_on: an independent reviewer must reconcile the ledger against a recording endpoint with injected pre- and post-usage failures

evidence.description: the request ledger and its usage-provenance rules

counterexamples: the ledger existed without request-path integration; it was not reachable from any provider

V1.blocked_on: the policy requires at least 60 nontrivial tasks across 6 pinned real repositories with preregistered, independently reviewed task selection; this repository has a synthetic fixture corpus and one 64-trial local sweep, which does not satisfy it

evidence.description: what the local sweep actually measured, and its limits
the raw records of the 64-trial local sweep

V2.blocked_on: the preregistered held-out corpus of V1 does not exist, so the acceptance rate and its confidence bound cannot be computed

evidence.description: the raw records of the local sweep, which the contract gate later showed contained false successes

counterexamples: 11 of 16 verified runs in the local sweep made no tool call at all; the contract gate now reports such a run as inconclusive rather than accepted

V3.blocked_on: the policy requires a paired comparison against a strong single-agent baseline with the same budgets over at least 20 eligible tasks across 4 repositories, with no post-hoc subset selection

evidence.description: the single-agent versus multi-agent comparison that was actually run, and what it does not establish

V4.blocked_on: the policy requires a second independent team on a separately administered machine; a second run by the implementation team is explicitly insufficient

evidence.description: the section that states which qualifications this repository cannot make

S1.blocked_on: an independent reviewer must reproduce the containment probe and the adversarial worker-command tests on a separately administered host

evidence.description: the bubblewrap containment backend and the probe that observes the boundary rather than assuming it
the environment builder no longer inherits the invoking user's HOME
the adversarial worker-command evidence: private home, host canary, denied network endpoint, system image, orphaned descendants, and refusal when containment is unavailable

counterexamples: the hardened guard previously reported the private-home boundary as satisfied while the environment builder kept the invoking user's HOME; the check now inspects the real configuration and directory

S2.blocked_on: an independent reviewer must attempt approval mutation, expiry, replay, replan and cross-run reuse, and the seeded-secret suite

evidence.description: approvals bound to the action, the workspace and the request
the policy engine that decides what a command may do

S3.blocked_on: the policy requires an audit by a reviewer independent of the implementation, with zero unresolved critical or high findings; a self-audit does not qualify

evidence.description: the threat model the audit would be measured against

M1.blocked_on: the qualification timing sample must be rerun with verified process ownership and a recorded resource baseline; the historical sweep carried a caveat and is retained with it

evidence.description: the timing conditions, including the residual-server caveat on the historical results
the raw records, retained rather than deleted

M2.blocked_on: an independent reviewer must reproduce the installation, verdicts, schema checks, recovery and metric generation on a clean supported machine

evidence.description: the pinned project metadata and the tool configuration
the assessor that enforces the policy's own rules over this record

U1.blocked_on: the policy requires 3 developers outside the implementation team, 30 consecutive days, 100 genuine runs across 3 repositories and 10 documented recovery exercises; none of this exists

evidence.description: the section that states which qualifications this repository cannot make

U2.blocked_on: the policy requires 90 consecutive days, 10 external users, 1000 genuine runs and 10 repositories; none of this exists

evidence.description: the section that states which qualifications this repository cannot make
